units.source_text: 顺着这个山坡一路下行前再下到坡脚，这里又是一个和前面差不多的茶馆。

en.t: After following this slope all the way down and then descending to the foot of it, there was another teahouse here much like the one before.

units.source_text: 两个工人进入茶馆，良平坐在矿车上，一心想着赶紧回去的事情。

en.t: The two workers went into the teahouse, while Ryohei sat on the mine cart thinking only about getting back as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 茶馆前面的梅花开得正盛，但洒在梅花上的阳光正日渐消散。

en.t: The plum blossoms in front of the teahouse were in full bloom, but the sunlight falling on them was gradually fading.
The sun is about to set behind the mountains.

units.source_text: 良平想到这里，觉得不能这么盲目的做下去了。

en.t: When Ryohei thought of this, he felt he could not go on acting so blindly.

units.source_text: 他不时用脚踢踢车轮，试图推动矿车，

en.t: From time to time he kicked the wheels with his feet, trying to set the mine cart moving,

units.source_text: 尽管他心里明白自己一个人根本无法推动，但还是不时试探——

en.t: even though he knew in his heart that he could never move it by himself, he still tried now and then--

units.source_text: 他不过是来一次消除自己内心的不安情绪。

en.t: He was only trying, just once, to ease the uneasiness in his own heart.
